phases.goal: The complete Workshop Cut Planner prototype: entry of blade width, boards and pieces in mm; to-scale kerf-aware layout; unplaced explanations with add-board and move; local-storage persistence with clear-plan; printable cut sheet.

Iteration 2: a millimetres/inches selector; entry, layout, unplaced explanations, move refusals and the cut sheet in the selected unit with lengths kept in millimetres; the selected unit saved and restored, and iteration 1 plans reopening unchanged in millimetres.
